verdict.rationale: Productboard documents attributing feedback to customers: it associates feedback with users and companies and records customer attribution and source metadata. Feedback notes link to features to quantify demand and inform prioritization, and the marketing copy explicitly cites sharing customer context to focus on what really matters. Much of this evidence is API-level rather than a description of the in-app experience. Missing for 10: evidence of richer customer attributes (e.g., segment or revenue) shown alongside feedback in the UI, a first-party walkthrough of the prioritization view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
